# Nextravox Tech

> Custom static HTML web development, monthly website maintenance (Pure HTML & WordPress), AI-generated ("vibe coding") page deployment, and WordPress-to-static HTML migration based in Penang, Malaysia.

## Core Services
1. **Monthly Website Maintenance — Pure HTML / Static Sites:** Routine text, image, and banner updates, SSL certificate and domain expiry management, 24/7 uptime checks, off-site backups, and fast bug fixes.
2. **Monthly Website Maintenance — WordPress Sites:** Safe WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates, automated off-site database/media backups, database transient cleanup, malware checks, routine content edits, and white-screen crash recovery.
3. **Host & Deploy AI-Generated ("Vibe Coding") Pages:** Taking frontend code generated via ChatGPT, Claude, v0, or Bolt, fixing mobile responsive issues, wiring custom domain DNS and SSL certificates, integrating spam-protected PHP contact forms, and deploying onto fast production hosting.
4. **One-Page Landing Page Creation:** Hand-coded, fast-loading responsive single-page websites built from scratch without bloated page builders or commercial templates.
5. **WordPress-to-Static HTML Migration:** Converting sluggish, plugin-heavy WordPress brochure websites into sub-1-second static HTML with zero database security vulnerabilities and lower annual hosting costs.
6. **Technical SEO & Speed Optimization:** Core Web Vitals optimization, metadata, JSON-LD structured schema, and Google Search Console indexing.

## Pricing Model
- **Monthly Maintenance (Pure HTML or WordPress):** Fixed **RM 275 / month** per website with no long-term lock-in contracts.
- **Multi-Site / Clinic Group Maintenance Bundle:** From **RM 175 / site / month** for businesses managing 2 or more websites.
- **Optional Monthly Technical SEO Add-On:** **+ RM 150 / month**.
- **One-Off Projects (One-Page Landing Pages, AI Page Deployment, WP-to-Static Migration):** One-time project fee with **no mandatory monthly fee**, quoted transparently based on page length, content readiness, and required features (such as 4-language switching or custom PHP forms).
